"""Plot same-slice finite support witnesses against matched source colors."""
import hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

source=Path('results/gauge_boundary_N6_F21_component_slices.json')
report=json.loads(source.read_text())
cases={}
for stage in report['stages']:
 candidate=stage.get('convex_repair',{})
 comparison=candidate.get('same_color_source_comparison')
 if comparison:
  cases[comparison['source_color']]=(candidate,comparison)
colors={'light_pink':'#e99494','pink':'#ec5555','red':'#be1616'}
styles={'light_pink':':','pink':'--','red':'-'}
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(13,4.3))
for ax,(channel,waveindex) in zip(axes,[('S0',0),('P1',1),('S2',2)]):
 for color in ['light_pink','pink','red']:
  candidate,comparison=cases[color];data=comparison['channels'][channel]
  phase=np.asarray(candidate['phase_curve']['phase_degrees'])[:,waveindex]
  ax.plot(candidate['phase_curve']['energy_GeV'],phase,color=colors[color],ls=styles[color],lw=1.6,
          label=color.replace('_',' ')+' finite support')
  ax.scatter(data['energy_GeV'],data['source_phase_degrees'],facecolors='none',edgecolors=colors[color],s=14,lw=.8)
 ax.set_title(channel);ax.set_xlabel('Energy (GeV)');ax.set_ylabel('Phase (degrees)')
 ax.set_xlim(.279,1.2);ax.grid(alpha=.18)
axes[1].axhline(90,color='0.55',lw=.6,zorder=0)
axes[0].legend(fontsize=7,loc='best')
fig.suptitle('Gauge upper-support witnesses at the three published f00 slices',fontsize=13)
fig.text(.5,.012,'Lines: finite-feasible convex repairs, N6/F21, componentwise χ=0.002, raw FESR norm.  Open circles: same-color published markers.  Continuum checks fail.',ha='center',fontsize=8)
fig.tight_layout(rect=[0,.045,1,.93])
for suffix in ['pdf','png']:
 fig.savefig('results/gauge_boundary_phase_comparison.'+suffix,dpi=180)
metadata=dict(candidate_source=str(source),candidate_sha256=hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 interpretation='Direct same-f00 upper-support comparison under stated finite conventions; computed repaired witnesses pass finite constraints but fail continuum checks. Source phase values were not fitted.',
 script_source_utf8=Path(__file__).read_text(),cases={color:dict(point=c['point'],mixture_fraction=c['seed_fraction'],objective_loss=c['objective_loss'],source_point=s['selected_source_point'],phase_rmse_degrees={channel:d['phase_rmse_degrees'] for channel,d in s['channels'].items()}) for color,(c,s) in cases.items()})
Path('results/gauge_boundary_phase_comparison.metadata.json').write_text(json.dumps(metadata,indent=2)+'\n')
print('wrote same-color phase comparison PDF and PNG')
